definitions.attribute: The raw query span after the prefix 'Who likes ' and before the final '?'. Case is preserved.
definitions.attribute_occurs: Case-sensitive Python substring test of that attribute against the document text. Titles are empty and are not searched.
definitions.irrelevant_doc: A corpus document whose _id is not one of the query's two qrel corpus-ids.
definitions.tokenizer: Lowercase, then maximal [a-z0-9]+ runs. Whitespace and punctuation are separators and are not tokens.
definitions.bm25: score(q, d) = sum_t idf(t) * tf(t,d) * (k1 + 1) / (tf(t,d) + k1 * (1 - b + b * |d| / avgdl)), idf(t) = ln(1 + (N - df(t) + 0.5) / (df(t) + 0.5)), k1=1.5, b=0.75. Each query term type contributes once. Document length and df are computed inside the corpus being evaluated. Terms absent from the corpus contribute nothing.
definitions.substring_baseline: score 1 when the raw attribute is a substring of the document text, else 0.
definitions.tie_break: Sort by score descending, then by document _id ascending (byte/Unicode lexicographic).
definitions.recall: Macro-average over the 1000 queries of |top-k intersect relevant| / 2, reported as a percentage (paper scale, 100 = perfect).
definitions.qrel_graph: 46 relevant people as nodes. Undirected edge if some query has that pair as its two relevant documents. density = |E| / C(46, 2). mean_queries_per_person averages, over people, the number of queries that list them.

dataset_alignment.note: These local files do not match the usual LIMIT construction in which limit-small is the 46 relevant documents of the same 1000 queries. Query strings, relevant people, and relevant pairs differ, so each split is evaluated with its own queries, corpus, and qrels.

limit-small.definition: Undirected simple graph on people who appear in at least one qrel. An edge exists when at least one query lists that pair as its two relevant documents. density = |E| / C(|V|, 2). mean_queries_per_person is the average, over people, of how many queries include that person.

limit.definition: Undirected simple graph on people who appear in at least one qrel. An edge exists when at least one query lists that pair as its two relevant documents. density = |E| / C(|V|, 2). mean_queries_per_person is the average, over people, of how many queries include that person.
